paragraphs: Coursedog sells software that colleges and universities use to run academic operations, pulling scheduling, curriculum, catalogs and assessment into one system. The products are grouped into a Curriculum Cloud, a Scheduling Cloud and an Assessment Cloud.

Scheduling tools sit on top of a campus student information system and sync changes as they happen. Data moves in real time across operational processes and between the student information system and the learning management system. A faculty workload module is built around data-driven workload decisions. Course demand projections are offered as a way to unblock pathways to graduation. Integrations cover homegrown and third-party student information systems.

The company says it serves more than 500 campuses and 3.5 million students. Chief information officers are among the roles the site addresses directly. A banner on the site announces the acquisition of ClassRanked to connect course evaluations across academic operations.
